text: ここを　ほりすすんで　みようぜ　かんぶが　いってた　おたから　この　おくかも　しれねえ

structure.jp: ここを　ほりすすんで　みようぜ
structure.en: let's try digging on through here

structure.jp: かんぶが　いってた　おたから
structure.en: the treasure the boss was talking about

structure.jp: この　おくかも　しれねえ

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: ほりすすんで　みようぜ
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form verb means doing it to see what happens; here it ends in みよう, 'let's'. ほりすすんで みよう = 'let's try digging on through'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: かんぶが　いってた　おたから
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing tells you which thing it is. いってた is short for いっていた. かんぶが いってた おたから = 'the treasure the boss was talking about'.

patterns.name: 〜かもしれない
patterns.span: おくかも　しれねえ
patterns.explanation: かもしれない says something is possible but not certain; しれねえ is a rough, tough-guy way of saying しれない. おくかも しれねえ = 'it might be further in'.
